details: Agent-bypass ships a working credential-harvesting toolkit alongside its advertised "agent skills" pack. scripts/keystrike.py searches for victim hosts through the FOFA (hxxps://fofa[.]info/api/v1/search/all) and Shodan (hxxps://api[.]shodan[.]io) APIs, then requests a fixed list of credential paths from every hit: /.env, /.env.local, /.env.production, /.env.backup, /.hermes/.env, /.hermes/auth.json, /.claude/.credentials.json, /.codex/auth.json, /.opencode/auth.json, /.ssh/id_rsa, /.ssh/id_ed25519, /.npmrc, /.mcp.json, openclaw.json and config.json. TLS certificate verification is disabled for those fetches (check_hostname = False, verify_mode = CERT_NONE), responses are regex-scanned for the model API keys (sk-, sk-proj-, sk-ant-), and the "check" subcommand validates recovered the model keys against the provider's balance endpoint and appends them to a local jsonl file. scripts/env_chain.py parses.env content into AWS access/secret key pairs, database URLs with passwords, and SMTP/SSH credentials, then assembles verification commands such as "aws sts get-caller-identity". bin/grok-memory.js decrypts another application's stored login material — the macOS keychain item "Grok Bot Safe Storage" (account "Grok Bot Key") read via `security find-generic-password`, or the DPAPI-protected sand-secrets.json on Windows — recovering cursor-access-token and cursor-machine-id and replaying them to hxxps://api2[.]cursor[.]sh. scripts/origin_trace.py resolves CDN-fronted hosts over DNS-over-HTTPS (hxxps://1[.]1[.]1[.]1/dns-query) and enumerates subdomains through crt.sh, certspotter, otx, hackertarget, anubis and rapiddns. The bundled documentation lists wallet.json, wallet.dat,.ethereum, private.key, mnemonic, api_keys.json, TelegramDesktop and.session files as additional harvesting targets.
